items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: when I went to Chicago I met him and we used to be around Clarence Williams

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to play with, when Al Huyte was playing with him.
A couple of other fellas that maybe they were, left Chicago, I mean they went up to Chicago and different places before you were grown. Richard M. Jones, Mione Jones, did you ever hear him?
Oh I know it, Mione Jones, before he left here and then when I went to Chicago I met him and we used to be around Clarence Williams when Clarence Williams had the music store. I know it.
